reason: I have run my practice on Excel and WhatsApp for ten years without paying for software, and with just one trainee I see no reason to commit ₹12,990 upfront. At most I would test the free pilot, but breaking our established routine requires software to be dead simple.
objection: I am a solo CA with one trainee—why should I ever upgrade beyond the free tier?
would_change_my_mind: If using the free pilot proves dead simple and saves several hours of weekly manual coordination without breaking my WhatsApp workflow.
